title: Prototype of my boat game
author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
selftext:
This is a multi tasking game where you need to steer the ship, remove water with a bucket when it rains, and catch fish. The goal is to keep the girl NPC alive (Who also tries to help you out). 

I am thinking of creating various levels of various difficulty. Some levels could have more rocks (obstacles). Others could have more storms. And there could be some sort of island to reach as a goal.

Entirely done with claude Code, except for the character and the voices.

I am not certain what is a good scope for this. I could fix the few remaining bugs, create a few levels, and post some sort of demo on itch.io. But i don't know if this concept is good enough for a Steam game (maybe a as a roguelike with several boats?).

Any feedback or ideas?

To be honest i did not pick her "best" sequence lol. She's not meant to be as effective as the player, but she does help get rid of water and she does catch some fishes.

comments.author: Kim_Laone
comments.body: You can think of other difficulties and obstacles besides rain and waves. Drinking water - collect in a bucket or a specially made filter-collector for rainwater. Maybe there will be seagulls sitting on some rocks and you can shoot them with a bow (you also need to craft it). After all, more than one fish will be eaten))

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
Actually yes that's probably a good idea to think of new ones.

Maybe later levels can introduce new problems instead of just worsening the weather

Drinking Water does not feel particularly "challenging" for the player, since it would refill automatically, and the girl would do that on her own, and at this point i think she's already doing random crap enough lol

comments.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
comments.body: I have some feedback, work on the actual gameplay before trying to make it look pretty. The second I heard that voice I knew I'd seen you post before, in 10 days you've posted like 7 different "games" and I'm just wondering like why? Is it that you're not really into the game once you start making it, or the ideas just aren't giving you enough inspiration like I understand trying different things but you keep posting every couple days and asking for feedback and ideas - where is it all going?? Are we giving you suggestions to just throw into the abyss or what?

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
Exactly. Actually i am playing my own games, and if i am not having fun then... i sometimes try different projects. The old project isn't literally deleted, but i am unsure what i will do with it.

This is the first game where i think "the prototype is actually fun, and this can be scaled".

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body: PVP would be fun but i think multiplayer is a bit outside of my scope for now. I am not really a game dev, i didn't touch a line of code.

comments.author: derAres
comments.body: I love the setting and idea. Also the waves and all - looks really decent so far. But what is the gameplay loop? Btw, the gal walks to effortless, somehow you need to account for the movement of the ship beneath het feet. It’s the main visual issue for me at least.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
The gameplay loop i'd describe it as a management game. It's trying to juggle getting the water out, actually steering the right direction, sending her to the bathroom at the correct time, and fishing when possible.

Yesterday i created a "Nightmare" difficulty and then it gets really hard.

replies.author: derAres
replies.body: Idea: what about some sort of „wave“ system where phases of peace alternate with wild phases. The tasks differ, like during peaceful phase you have to do repairs, eat, drink (otherwise your energy goes down and you will move Slower). Repairs could also involve jumping out and fixinh stuff while swimming. Possibly diving… maybe you can find a supernatural explanation.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
It's kinda already how it works

There is a "bag" of 5 events, including 1 storm and 1 rain. So you automatically get calmer times where you can fish, she can go to bathroom, she can eat. And harsh times where you both try to just survive.

However repair is actually something i have been considering.

Right now the only thing that hurts your ship is hitting rocks, but a good player never hits rocks.

My idea is to add SHARKS. Sharks could be detected by the girl (she tells you they're coming) and could possibly be shot by a harpoon. Sharks could literally damage the ship (which could later be repaired).

My issue is WHEN would those come, because if it comes during a storm then it might be a bit too tricky to handle. So maybe i'd add it as a bag event, not during storms.
